core_meaning.primary_meaning: Reham corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْم and is glossed in this record as “Mercy, compassion.” The record associates the form with root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Reham corresponds to the Arabic form رَحْم (Arabic root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m); رَحْم (Raḥm)). Its core sense is reham; mercy, compassion. Reham is Arabic رَحْم (Raḥm) 'mercy, compassion', from the root ر ح م (r-ḥ-m). The source gloss 'Content, Pleasing, Satiated' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: رحم
persian.long_meaning: Reham (رحم) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن رحم، رحمت است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

arabic.name: رَحْم
